run_sgld_sweep: run the sgld_sweep function to generate SGMCMCConfig instances for vanilla SGLD with varying learning rates and prior variances
run_momentum_sgld_sweep: run the momentum_sgld_sweep function to generate SGMCMCConfig instances for momentum SGLD with varying learning rates and prior variances
run_combined_sweep: run the combined_sweep function to return a combined tuple of vanilla SGLD and momentum SGLD sweep configurations
run_paper_agent: run the paper_agent function to create a PaperAgent with default SGMCMCConfig, make_agent constructor, and combined sweep
review_sgmcmc_sweeps: review the sgmcmc sweeps module that defines sweep configurations for SGLD and momentum SGLD agents
